serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText: You: Ah! Memories are rushing through my head. It seems like I really forget what’s happening here. This gotta be the weirdest trip ever… Mrs. Fisher deserves a life in prison for distributing these joints. What the hell is she thinking? I’m probably going to forget about all of this anyway, so there’s nothing I can do to stop this, so let’s just focus on getting the job done. I don’t see anyone here, though… What the hell am I supposed to do? ???: WOOP-WOOP{{punch}} W-What the hell?! That almost gave me a heart attack…
